entries.name: button
entries.about: A control the user presses to run an action. It can stay selected like a toggle, carry a menu of related actions, or be removed, so small buttons also cover tags, chips and badges.
entries.element: button (aria-pressed when selected; icon-only when it has no text, named by label; plus a menu button, aria-haspopup=menu, when it has options; plus a remove button when removable)
entries.notes: Consolidates button, toggle-button (its pressed state is selected) and split-button (its menu is options + open) on Alberto's call. Size is kept as a prop on his call; loading states were removed. Tag and badge are folded in too (Alberto's call): a small button, selected for a selected tag, removable for an input chip; tag's count goes into the text. Icons are in (Alberto's call): leadingIcon and trailingIcon name a Material Symbols glyph (its look stays in Figma), so the kits' icon and icon-swap properties map to them; with no text the button is icon-only, named by label. The menu and remove buttons draw expand_more and close.

entries.name: date-picker
entries.about: Lets the user pick a date, or a start and end date, from a calendar or by typing.
entries.notes: value holds one date, or start and end when range. Docked, dropdown, modal and input forms are one picker presented per breakpoint; day/month/year views are internal. Untitled Type=Available times (pick a time slot) dropped: a pattern on top.

entries.name: file-upload
entries.about: A drop zone the user drags files onto or browses from, listing queued files with progress.
entries.notes: Untitled only (its Input field Type=File upload is the compact form).

entries.name: form
entries.about: Groups inputs the user fills in and submits together.
entries.notes: No kit set; kept from primitives.json.

entries.name: input
entries.about: A field the user types a value into, on one line or, when multiline, several.

untitled: Type: Default/Leading dropdown/Trailing dropdown/Leading text/Payment input/… (+5)

entries.notes: checkbox and radio move out of input to their own entries. Untitled Type packs compound inputs: OTP and file upload have their own entries; leading/trailing dropdown, payment, tags and trailing button are composed. textarea is folded in (Alberto's call): multiline draws a textarea, with the same label, hint, value and states; type applies to one line only. Color is an input type (Alberto's call), so colour pickers compose from it.

entries.name: otp-input
entries.about: Boxes the user types a short verification code into, one digit each.
entries.notes: Untitled only. Split from input: focus moves box to box and it completes at length.

entries.name: slider
entries.about: A handle the user drags along a track to set one number, or two handles, when range, to set a low and a high one.
entries.element: input type=range (two role=slider handles on one track when range)
entries.notes: Material only. Centered slider is a slider whose min is below zero. Show stops means a step. range-slider is folded in (Alberto's call): range draws two handles on one track for start and end, which fire changeStart and changeEnd (the vocabulary has no number pair); one handle fires change.

entries.name: checkbox
entries.about: A box the user ticks, or a switch they flip, to turn one option on or off.
entries.element: input type=checkbox (role=switch when role is switch)
entries.notes: Today it is input type=checkbox; split out since it carries a bool and an indeterminate state. Untitled Type=Radio is the radio-group control. switch is folded in (Alberto's call): role switch draws the track and thumb and applies at once; same checked and change. indeterminate is for the checkbox role.

entries.name: radio-group
entries.about: A set of options the user picks exactly one of, as radios or a row of joined buttons.
entries.element: role=radiogroup of input type=radio (or of buttons, as a segmented control)
entries.notes: Material has a lone radio button; behaviour lives at the group. Untitled radio cards (icon, avatar, payment) are visual; its Type=Checkbox cards are a set of checkboxes. segmented-control is folded in (Alberto's call): the same single choice, so one entry and one template; a segmented control is a horizontal radio-group drawn as joined buttons.

entries.name: select
entries.about: A field the user opens to pick one option, or several when multiple, from a list.
entries.element: select (role=listbox aria-multiselectable in a popup when multiple)
entries.notes: Untitled only (Material's exposed dropdown is not in the kit read). Type=Search filters options as you type, a combobox: kept as searchable rather than an entry with no set of its own. Type=Tags is multi-select. multi-select is folded in (Alberto's call): multiple picks into values and shows them as pills, with picked options ticked; change carries the picked options, one item when single.

entries.name: link
entries.about: Text or a badge the user follows to another page or site.
entries.notes: App store badges are links to a store page. Untitled's link-styled buttons stay buttons.

entries.name: tree-view
entries.about: A nested list the user expands and collapses to browse and pick items, like folders.
entries.notes: Untitled only. items as text[] cannot express depth; it needs a tree type. Items bind to a data model with a label and children of the same model.

entries.name: progress
entries.about: Shows how far along a task is, or that something is loading when it can't say.
entries.notes: Linear, circular, wavy and spinners are one control: a value, or none when indeterminate. Material splits its expressive loading indicator from progress; behaviour is the same.

entries.name: toast
entries.about: A brief message that pops up about something that just happened, with an optional action.
entries.notes: Material Snackbar and Untitled Notification. Untitled's icon, avatar and image types are visual; its progress type puts a progress inside.

entries.name: dialog
entries.about: A window over the page, centred or sliding in from an edge, that asks the user to read, decide or fill something in; modal ones block the page behind a backdrop.
entries.element: dialog (modal, with a backdrop) or a non-modal panel; on an edge unless placement is center
entries.notes: List and scrollable-list dialogs differ only in content. Untitled Modal's 51 Types are content examples (sign-up, invite, payment…) composed from primitives. sheet is folded in (Alberto's call): placement puts it centred or on the left, right or bottom edge (side, bottom and slide-out sheets); a non-modal one has no backdrop and leaves the page usable.

entries.name: menu
entries.about: A list of actions or choices the user opens from a button, or by right-clicking an area, and picks one from.
entries.element: role=menu (from a button, or opened by contextmenu on the area it wraps)

untitled: Type: Button simple/Button advanced/Button link/Icon simple/Icon advanced/… (+7)

entries.notes: Untitled Dropdown menu Type sets the trigger (button, icon, avatar, account card); its Search types filter items. A menu item's Selected is the checked item (value). FAB menu is a menu opened from a FAB. context-menu is folded in (Alberto's call): trigger contextmenu opens it by right-click or long-press on the area it wraps, its children; a click menu hangs off its button and has none.

entries.name: popover
entries.about: A small panel anchored to a control: opened by a click, with text and actions, until the user dismisses it; or, on hover or focus, a short tooltip.
entries.element: [popover] role=dialog (non-modal); role=tooltip when trigger is hover
entries.notes: Material Rich Tooltip: it holds actions and stays open, so it is a popover, not a tooltip. tooltip is folded in (Alberto's call): a hover popover is the tooltip, shown on hover or focus with its text only (no title, no actions). Rich Tooltip is the click popover: it holds actions and stays open.

entries.name: list
entries.about: A column of items the user scans, selects, reorders or swipes for actions.
entries.notes: Material only. Drag and swipe lists add behaviour (reorder, reveal actions); items hold checkbox, radio or switch by composition. Expandable lists are accordions.

entries.name: table
entries.about: Rows and columns of records the user scans, sorts and selects rows in.

untitled.name: Table cell lead action (sub-part: row select)

entries.notes: Untitled only. Cells are composition (avatar, badge, progress, actions). A Radio lead action makes selection single. Cell State Hover/selected conflates hover with selection: dropped. Rows bind to a data model; columns name its fields.

entries.name: text
entries.about: A piece of text.
entries.notes: No kit set; kept from primitives.json.

entries.name: container
entries.about: A box that lays out other components. It can be pressed as a whole (a card, a nav item, a tab) and carry a role: a landmark, a tab list or tab panel, a live region.
entries.element: div (role from role; role=button when pressable, link when it also has href; aria-current from current, aria-selected on a tab, aria-expanded with aria-controls when it controls another container)
entries.notes: Button, chip and social-button groups only lay their items out; single-row vs wrap is container layout. Pressable containers and roles are in (Alberto's call): pressable (a button, or a link with href) covers cards and nav items; role gives landmarks, toolbars, tabs and tab panels, and live regions (alert, status); current, selected, expanded and controls carry aria-current, aria-selected, aria-expanded and aria-controls. How these combine is in the README's composition rules.

entries.name: divider
entries.about: A line separating content, with an optional label.

untitled: Type: Button/Button group icon/Button group/Button icon

entries.notes: Direction and inset are visual. Untitled button types put buttons in the divider: composed.

entries.name: image
entries.about: A picture, with a fallback (such as initials) shown when it has no source or it fails to load.
entries.element: img (fallback when there is no src or it fails)
entries.notes: Replaces avatar (Alberto's call): an avatar is an image whose fallback is initials. Its status dot, verified mark and name beside it are composed; size and shape are style.

entries.name: video
entries.about: A video the user plays and pauses.
entries.notes: Untitled only.

composed.name: toolbar
composed.about: A bar of related actions the user moves through with arrow keys.

material.name: Bottom app bar (deprecated: replaced by docked toolbar)

composed.name: search
composed.about: A field the user types a query into, picking a suggestion or submitting the query.

composed.name: time-picker
composed.about: Lets the user pick a time of day on a dial or by typing.

composed.name: color-picker
composed.about: Lets the user pick a colour from swatches, sliders or a hex value. Its hex field is an input of type color.

composed.name: breadcrumbs
composed.about: The trail of pages above the current one; the user follows one back up.

composed.name: navigation
composed.about: The app's main destinations; the user picks one, and on small screens opens it as a drawer or menu.

composed.name: pagination
composed.about: Numbered pages and previous/next; the user moves between pages of results.

composed.name: stepper
composed.about: Shows the steps of a flow and which one the user is on.

untitled.name: Progress steps / Progress minimal icons connected
Progress steps / Progress text with line
Progress steps / Progress icons with text

composed.name: tabs
composed.about: A row of tabs the user switches between to show one panel at a time.

composed.name: alert
composed.about: A message in the page or across its top telling the user something they should know, with optional actions.

composed.name: command-palette
composed.about: A keyboard-summoned box the user types into to find and run commands or jump to things.

composed.name: accordion
composed.about: A heading the user opens and closes to show or hide its content.

composed.name: card
composed.about: A box grouping content about one thing, which the user may press as a whole.

composed.name: avatar-group
composed.about: Overlapping avatars of several people, with a +N count and an add button.

composed.name: carousel
composed.about: A row of items the user swipes or steps through one at a time.
